feed.title: StreamShōgun Changelog
feed.subtitle: Release notes, new features, and improvements for StreamShōgun.

entry.title: v0.2.1 — Stability & Safety Improvements
entry.summary:
New: IPC input validators (requireString, requireFiniteNumber), Discord reconnection backoff, PIP param validation, React ErrorBoundary component with retry button.

Improved: Removed dead secureFetch code, scheduler timeout guard, Discord RPC safety checks, PIP window cleanup, watch history transaction + auto-prune, Zustand .catch() guards, player page unhandled-rejection fixes.

Fixed: PLAYLIST_LOAD_URL gzip decompression bypass.

entry.title: v0.1.0 — Initial Release
entry.summary:
New Features: M3U playlist import, XMLTV EPG guides, smart channel matching (Pro), HLS playback, favorites & watch history, cloud sync (Pro), picture-in-picture (Pro), dark & light themes, auto refresh (Pro).

Improvements: Windows NSIS installer and portable EXE, search and filter across all channels, keyboard navigation for channel list, group channels by category.
